h1: Custom Recycled Safety Gear for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Recycled Safety Gear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled safety gear with your logo. Eco-friendly hard hats, vests & more. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Choosing recycled materials for your company's safety gear shows your team and clients that sustainability matters in every part of your operations. From hard hats made with post-consumer recycled plastic to high-visibility vests woven from recycled polyester, these eco-friendly options meet ANSI standards while reducing landfill waste. Perfect for construction crews, warehouse teams, or event staff who need reliable protection with a lower environmental footprint.
heroAltText: Custom recycled safety gear including hard hats and high-visibility vests with company logos
